title: Verification
panelText: Press the button below to re-/start verification!
hintText:
Type out the traced colored characters from left to right ➡️
Ignore all gray decoy characters
Ignore character cases (upper & lower case)
The captcha contains 4 characters
wrongInput:
That was wrong... Are you a robot?
Press Verify to try again with a new captcha
expired: This captcha has expired. Press Verify to get a new one.
kickMsg:
You have been kicked from `{{guild}}` because you didn't verify.
You can rejoin anytime with a valid invite link

settings.overviewDescription: Captcha verification for new members with optional kick timer.

descriptions.channel: The channel the verification panel is posted in
descriptions.logChannel: The channel verification starts are logged in
descriptions.pendingRole: Role given on join and removed once verified
descriptions.verifiedRole: Role given once a member verifies
descriptions.kick: Kick members that stay unverified for too long. Needs a Pending Role
descriptions.kickAfter: How long a member may stay unverified
descriptions.panelDesign: A design saved in the embed builder or component builder. A Verify button is added unless the design already has one. Placeholders: {{list}}

settings.postPanelDescription: Post a new verification panel in the start channel

reasons.kickOnly: Only shown while kicking is enabled

guide.title: Verification Setup Guide
guide.intro: Pick the channel the verification panel lives in, set the verified role, post the panel, then enable the system.
guide.advertText: **New here?** The Setup Guide walks you through the verification options.

errors.notEnabled: Verification is not enabled in this server.
errors.panelFailed: I couldn't post the panel. Check that I can view and send messages in the start channel.
